race.comment: SHENTON ROAD (11) resumes having placed at this trip and then contested NMW grade at Belmont Park before a break. The latest Belmont Park trial adds enough readiness, and the prior second at Pinjarra Scarpside gives her a solid Mdn platform. Can return with a bang. MISS BILLIE JEAN (12) brings the cleanest recent debut form, closing strongly for second at Northam as favourite and having WAR TRAIL behind her there. Sticky draw again, but with some luck then she can land the knockout blow. WARDIKCAR (2) is worth another chance after being bumped and covering ground at Bunbury, with his narrow second two back showing he is well up to this. BOURBONONTHEROCKS (9) was professional enough on debut over 1100m at Northam and had trialled well beforehand. Straight to 1400m is a query, though his fresh ratings stack up. WAR TRAIL (3) was solid off a long break last start and can improve with that run under his belt.
